description: Etat des parkings en temps réel - Ville de Nîmes is a dataset listed in data.nimes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Nîmes. Données sur les disponibilités des parkings (Indigo, Interparking, QPark) en temps réel de la ville de Nîmes. Coverage: Nîmes Métropole. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are Transport, Mobilité, Parking. The portal shows 7 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2020-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nimes-metropole-fr-portal.
